title: Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Part One: Format of Internet Message Bodies

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 2045 explicitly describes RFC 822 message bodies as flat US-ASCII text and extends the message format to support other character sets, non-text content and multipart bodies.
MIME introduces media typing and transfer-encoding mechanisms as representation extensions rather than replacing SMTP transport.

notes: Later MIME-generation source; earlier RFC 934/1341/1521/1522 genealogy remains a priority.
